name: Stitch -Kakechigaeta Button-
source:
Main character is the owner of a clothes brand for teens. However, he is also pervert and sadist who insults girls wearing clothes of his design.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角经营一个面向青少年的服装品牌，却也是个变态的施虐狂，专门侮辱穿着自己设计服装的女孩。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-december-2002-popotan.html]vndbreview[/url]]
